feedback:
You find yourself in a kitchen. An usual one.

As if things weren't amazing enough already, you can even see a refrigerator. You see a counter. The counter is typical. However, the counter, like an empty counter, has nothing on it. This always happens, here in TextWorld! You make out a stove. But the thing is empty. Hey, want to see a kitchen island? Look over there, a kitchen island. The kitchen island is ordinary. On the kitchen island you can make out a note.

There is a closed screen door leading east. There is an open wooden door leading west. You don't like doors? Why not try going north, that entranceway is unblocked. There is an exit to the south. Don't worry, it is unguarded.
